class AgentState(TypedDict):
    messages: Annotated[list, add_messages]


def message_text(message) -> str:
    """Plain text of a message whose content may be a string or a list of blocks."""
    content = message.content
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    return "".join(b.get("text", "") for b in content if isinstance(b, dict))


def agent_input(system_prompt: str, history: list) -> list:
    """System prompt + the shared history as ONE user turn: earlier agents' replies are context for
    this agent, not its own turns (and Claude 5.5 models reject requests ending on an assistant turn)."""
    parts = [
        f"{'Request' if m.type == 'human' else 'Output from ' + (m.name or 'a previous step')}:\n{message_text(m)}"
        for m in history
    ]
    return [SystemMessage(content=system_prompt), HumanMessage(content="\n\n".join(parts) or "(no input)")]

    """Code Analyzer"""
    llm = ChatOpenAI(model="gpt-4o", temperature=0.3, max_tokens=1024)

    reply.name = "analyzer"
    return {"messages": [reply]}
